evidence.title: GitHub - usekaneo/kaneo: Open source project management that works for you, not against you.

name: Kaneo
summary: Open-source, self-hostable project management with kanban boards, backlog, Gantt and GitHub sync.
description: An MIT-licensed project management platform you can self-host with Docker Compose or a Helm chart on PostgreSQL (Redis optional). It covers kanban boards, list and calendar views, backlog planning, Gantt charts, subtasks, dependencies, labels, priorities, comments, attachments, time tracking and workspace roles, with GitHub/Gitea sync, chat integrations, webhooks, a REST API, a CLI client and an MCP server for AI agents. Kaneo Cloud is the managed EU-hosted option.
contains: MIT licensed; self-hosting free with every feature incl. SSO
Board, list, calendar and Gantt views plus backlog, filters and search
Subtasks, dependencies, labels, priorities, comments, attachments and time tracking
GitHub/Gitea sync, chat integrations, webhooks, REST API, CLI client and MCP server
One application container plus PostgreSQL via Docker Compose or Helm chart; Redis optional
Custom roles, workspace permissions and live updates
